title: Pokémon Night Out: recompensa na Twitch
fact_checks: Official Pokémon GO stream starts October 24, 2026 at 7:30 p.m. PDT.
Watching 30 minutes grants a code for exclusive Timed Research.
Completing the Timed Research awards a Pokémon Night Out baseball jersey for the avatar.
The official announcement does not state an end time.
candidate_visual: Cinematic luminous abstract livestream arena with a plain baseball jersey; no species, coordinates, venue, team branding, end time, or bonus claim.
prompt_summary: Arena de transmissao noturna cinematografica em azul e roxo, camisa de beisebol sem marca, identidade Spidey oficial sobreposta e somente horario, duracao de audiencia e recompensa confirmados pela fonte oficial.
